text: Added A-001. "I found a lost package" is not an operational disruption because it does not report a supplier delay, a plant outage, or a quality hold. No operational records are affected. Nothing was written.

Added A-002. "A supplier delivered unauthorized package" is not an operational disruption because it does not report a supplier delay, a plant outage, or a quality hold. No operational records are affected. Nothing was written.

Added A-003. "there was a supplier delay" is not an operational disruption because it does not report a supplier delay, a plant outage, or a quality hold. No operational records are affected. Nothing was written.
